command.inverse_fn: Compute the inverse function by solving y = f(var) for var.
command.apply_identity: Apply the named algebraic identity to the expression.
command.total_diff: Total derivative applying the chain rule over all declared dependencies.
command.divergence: Divergence of a vector field: sum of partial derivatives ∂Fᵢ/∂xᵢ.
command.laplacian: Laplacian of a scalar field: sum of second partial derivatives ∂²f/∂xᵢ².
command.taylor: Taylor expansion of {expr} in {var} around {center} to order {order}.
command.laurent: Laurent expansion of {expr} in {var} around {center} to order {order}.
command.asymptotic: Asymptotic expansion of {expr} as {var} → ∞ to order {order}.
command.revert: Lagrange reversion of the Taylor series of {expr} in {var} to order {order}.
command.residue: Compute the residue of {expr} at {point} in {var}.
command.optimize: Optimise {objective} over {vars} subject to constraints; sense {sense}.
command.lagrange_mult: Apply Lagrange multipliers to {objective} over {vars} with equality constraints.
command.factor.partial: Full factoring engine is not yet wired into the API; result is the canonical simplification.
command.rearrange: Rearrange equation to isolate the named variable.
command.solve_system: Simultaneous solution of a system of equations.
_pde_namespace_reserved: PDE step templates (step.pde_*) reserved for E-ode-systems-pde PRD.
step.chain_rule: Chain rule $(f \circ g)' = f'(g) \cdot g'$: outer {outer} composed with {inner} → {output}.
step.column_space_computation: Column space basis: columns {columns} of the original matrix (pivot positions)
step.frobenius_method: Frobenius method at regular singular point {x0}: indicial roots {roots}, series {output}.
step.gram_schmidt: Gram-Schmidt: orthogonalize column {j} against {prev_count} previous vectors
step.implicit_differentiation: Implicit differentiation of $F(x, y) = 0$ gives $dy/dx = -F_x / F_y$: {output}.
step.l_hopital_rule: L'Hôpital's rule ($\frac{0}{0}$ or $\frac{\infty}{\infty}$): differentiate numerator and denominator: {output}.
step.move_term: Move {term} to the other side (sign change): {input} → {output}.
step.null_space_computation: Null space basis vector {index}: free variable x_{free_var} = 1
step.power_both_sides: Raise both sides to the power {exp}: {input} → {output}.
step.power_rule: Power rule: $d/d{var}\, {input} = {output}$ (bring down exponent, reduce by 1).
step.rank_computation: Matrix has rank {rank} ({pivot_count} pivot columns in RREF)
step.root_both_sides: Take the {n}-th root of both sides: {input} → {output}.
step.secant: Secant method: $x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n) \cdot (x_n - x_{n-1}) / (f(x_n) - f(x_{n-1}))$: {output}.
step.separation_of_variables: Separate variables: {lhs} d{lvar} = {rhs} d{rvar}, integrate both sides: {output}.
step.symbolic_eigenvector: Eigenvector for eigenvalue {eigenvalue}: solve (A - λI)v = 0 via null space
step.taylor_expansion: Taylor expansion of {f} about {a} to order {n}: {output}.
step.total_differential: Total differential via chain rule over {deps}: {output}.
